figures.finding: Not found. Neither the EDB guideline nor the NAF guidelines caps a producer's fee or overheads; the guideline lists production service company fees as qualifying. No MBC commissioning terms were reachable.

sources.said: List of Qualifying Production Expenditures ... • Production service company fees • Professional services (such as insurance and accounting services) • Remuneration for cast and crew ... The following expenditures are excluded and not considered as QPE for Digital Animation Projects • Purchase of depreciating asset ... • Overhead expenses such as rental of office space, utilities bill and telecommunication cost • Administrative salaries • Marketing and distribution cost.
